description: A tool for dynamic reflective problem-solving through thoughts. Record one thinking step at a time, revise earlier thoughts, and branch into alternative lines of reasoning; the server tracks the thought history and branches for the life of the session.

isRevision.description: Whether this revises a previous thought

nextThoughtNeeded.description: Whether another thought step is needed

totalThoughts.description: Estimated total thoughts needed (numeric value, e.g., 5, 10)

name: sequentialthinking
